Hi Justin,

Thanks for the update, and sorry the Duster is still outstanding. Your Magicminer MO01 and the Helium Mobile hotspot were delivered on October 5, so that part is done.

The D. was set for October 15 and it has not shipped. It is sitting at the warehouse waiting on stock, and I do not have a new date for it yet, so I am not going to guess at one. A colleague is picking that up and will write to you here with the confirmed date. The team is offline over the weekend and comes back Monday at 10am ET, so you will have it from them then. In the meantime you can follow the incoming shipments at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status.

On the giveaways, anything we are running on the site applies to new orders at checkout rather than to one already placed, so it will not change this one.

Nothing else is needed from you, your Duster is still on the order and goes out as soon as stock lands.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
